data.title: Preview: Bolton Wanderers vs West Bromwich Albion - prediction, team news, lineups - Sports Mole
data.content:
Kareem Tunde and Price both picked up minor knocks in South Wales, meaning there could be further attacking alterations from the Baggies.

Mikey Johnston is nearing a return from the treatment room, although right-back Noah Galves (knee) is sidelined for the remainder of the campaign.

Bolton Wanderers possible starting lineup:

Bazunu; Stephenson, Brunt, Famewo, Conway; Simons, Sheehan, Larrazabal, Rodrigues, Illing-Junior; Dalby

West Bromwich Albion possible starting lineup: [...] ## Team News

Starting on his natural right wing last time out, Bolton attacker Larrazabal picked up a slight knock, meaning that he is a doubt for Wednesday night.

On the other flank, Illing-Junior is set to face off against his former loan club, with Ruben Rodrigues and leading marksman Dalby completing the forward line.

Coming off the bench in Swansea on the weekend, West Brom's Aune Heggebo is pushing for a start at the expense of Norway international Felix Horn Myhre. [...] O'Leary; Pereira, Mepham, Campbell, Styles; Whitwell, Molumby, Nzingoula, Price; Morgan, Heggebo

## We say: Bolton Wanderers 1-2 West Bromwich Albion

After passing up a good opportunity to claim three points on the weekend, Bolton now face one of the promotion contenders on home soil.

West Brom have themselves to blame for their failure to win at Swansea, however, the Baggies should be able to make amends on Wednesday night.

West Bromwich Albion have picked up 29 points from their 16 Championship games to sit fifth in the league table, level on points with fourth-placed Birmingham City and three points behind league leaders Middlesbrough.

## Bolton Wanderers vs West Bromwich Albion Head-To-Head and Key Numbers [...] Bolton have picked up five wins and three draws from their 16 Championship matches so far to collect 18 points and sit 18th in the league standings, but a win could see them rise to 15th place on Wednesday.

Like the home side, West Bromwich Albion were involved in a share of the spoils last weekend when they played out a 2-2 stalemate with Swansea City at the Swansea.com Stadium.
